Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 148. Category: technique. Rank 4.

Rank 4 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 80 ki
Prerequisites: none
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: 20 feet
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Omni
Gogeta’s strongest move. Hyper condensed Ki is
thrown at a high velocity at an opponent. Roll a ranged
ki attack dealing 20d6 damage ki damage on a hit. Can
crit on a 19 or 20.
